description.text: AI-written synthesis of the cited official pages, prepared by the collecting assistant: a16z speedrun backs early-stage founders with capital, customer introductions, hiring support, and a twelve-week in-person residency in San Francisco. The standard deal is $500,000 for 10% upfront on a SAFE, plus up to $500,000 in a qualifying next round of at least $2 million within 18 months; the additional investment is conditional, not part of the fixed 10% exchange. The Program also advertises partner credits and Demo Day. Residencies run twice a year. SR008 starts February 1, 2027; the application page and FAQ disagree on its end date (April 16 versus April 18), so no exact end date is asserted here. The SR008 deadline has passed, but the Program says applications are reviewed year-round for the following residency.

targetApplicants.text: AI-written synthesis of the cited official pages, prepared by the collecting assistant: speedrun considers founders with an idea, prototype, or early product and a team already building; prior fundraising does not rule out an application. Solo founders can apply. It backs teams across almost every sector, with examples including AI, robotics, fintech, consumer, B2B, and security, rather than only games. Founders should be able to build and iterate themselves, usually through a technical cofounder or equivalent founding-team expertise. Participation is in person in San Francisco and founders are expected to build full-time. The separate alpha fellowship is presented as an alternative for students and recent graduates still finding their idea or team; it is not the speedrun deal described here.

sources.title: a16z speedrun official site — linked brand icon
speedrun Residency — format and duration
sources.quote:
Every speedrun company spends twelve weeks in person at our office in San Francisco.

Twelve weeks of content and community, plus six months of office access.

sources.title: Apply to speedrun — SR008 and year-round review
sources.quote:
SR008 runs February 1 to April 16, 2027, in San Francisco. If you apply after November 1, we’ll consider you for the following residency. We review applications year-round, so whenever you’re ready, we’d love for you to apply.

Capital: Up to $1M, plus $10M+ in credits from 200+ partners through the speedrun Marketplace.

sources.title: speedrun FAQ — Capital and terms
sources.quote:
Our standard deal is up to $1M: $500K for 10% upfront on a SAFE, and up to an additional $500K in your next qualifying round ($2M+) within 18 months. Our current standard deal does not include a board seat. We ask for pro rata rights in future rounds and for an option pool for your early hires. Your investing partner will walk you through every detail before you sign.

Credits unlock once your investment is wired. Amounts and terms are set by each partner and can change.

sources.title: speedrun FAQ — cadence and published residency dates
sources.quote:
Twice a year, both in San Francisco. SR008 starts in February 2027. SR009 starts in late July 2027, with Demo Day on October 5, 2027.

The SR008 residency runs February 1 to April 18, 2027, with the founder retreat February 2 to 4 and Demo Day on April 13.

sources.title: speedrun FAQ — exact SR008 deadline and later applications
sources.quote: Applications for the SR008 residency are open October 12 through November 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM PT. If you miss the window, don't worry. You can still apply, and we'll review your application for the next residency.

sources.title: speedrun FAQ — stages, teams, and prior funding
sources.quote:
Very early. An idea, a prototype, or an early product, with a team that's already building. We've backed founders before they left their jobs.

You can apply to speedrun as a solo founder.

We aim to be the first check into your company, but we also accept early-stage companies that have already raised capital.

We back teams that can build and iterate on their product themselves, which usually means having a technical cofounder or equivalent expertise on the founding team.

sources.title: speedrun FAQ — sector breadth and separate alpha fellowship
sources.quote:
We invest in founders across almost every sector, from AI and robotics to fintech, consumer, B2B, security, and more. What matters most to us is the team, not the category.

The alpha fellowship invests up to $250K plus credits in students, recent grads, and dropouts who are still finding their idea, product, or team. speedrun invests up to $1M in founders who are already building, or further along in their careers, with an idea, a product, and a team.

sources.title: speedrun FAQ — commitment and international founders
sources.quote:
The residency is designed to be in person and full-time in San Francisco, since that's where most of the value comes from.

If you're coming from outside the US, Build in America can help with visas, banking, and housing.

sources.title: speedrun FAQ — reported selectivity and public contact
sources.quote:
Recent residencies have had 70 to 80 companies. Fewer than 0.4% of applicants are accepted.

If you need further help, don't hesitate to contact us
